entries.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Pokémon\nCenter! Do your precious Pokémon need a rest?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_01_01

entries.text: Hello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center!\nAre your Pokémon tired and in need of rest?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_01_02

entries.text: Welcome to the Pokémon Center! Still up and\nabout? Are you here to rest your tired Pokémon?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_01_03

entries.text: I’d like to heal my Pokémon
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_select_01

entries.text: I don’t know where to go...
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_select_02

entries.text: Can I register my birthday?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_select_04

entries.text: I’m all good!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_select_03

entries.text: Then we’ll need your Pokémon for a few seconds!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_02_02

entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_02_05

entries.text: Come back and see us again whenever you need!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_02_04

entries.text: Oh, and I went ahead and charged up your\nTera Orb too.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_02_06

entries.text: Right! Let’s see—if I had to recommend a next\ndestination for you...
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_01

entries.text: I’d guess a fresh-faced student belongs in school!\c\nHead to Naranja Academy, why don’t you?\nYou must be excited to join your class!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_20a

entries.text: I’d guess a fresh-faced student belongs in school!\c\nHead to Uva Academy, why don’t you? You must\nbe excited to join your class!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_20b

entries.text:
I’d guess there are still corners of the academy
you haven’t checked out.\c
Don’t be afraid to visit different rooms—
who knows who you’ll end up meeting!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_21a

entries.text:
I’d guess there are still corners of the academy
you haven’t checked out.\c
Don’t be afraid to go into different rooms—
who knows who you’ll end up meeting!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_21b

entries.text: ...Nope! Sorry, I’ve got nothing!\c\nYou’re ready for anything Paldea could possibly\nthrow at you, so I’d say go wherever you’d like!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_00

entries.text: You should pay a visit to the Cortondo Gym!\c\nHave you considered trying to take on Gym\nLeader Katy in charming Cortondo?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_01

entries.text: I’d recommend the Artazon Gym!\c\nHave you thought about taking on Gym Leader\nBrassius? He’s in picturesque Artazon!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_02

entries.text: Well, how about the Cascarrafa Gym?\c\nYou could try taking on Gym Leader Kofu in\nrefreshing Cascarrafa!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_03

entries.text: I’d aim for the Levincia Gym!\c\nYou could try challenging Gym Leader Iono in\nthe dazzling city of Levincia!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_04

entries.text: I think you’d better visit the Medali Gym!\c\nYou could try taking on Gym Leader Larry next.\nYou’ll find him in good old Medali.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_05

entries.text: I’d say it’s time for the Glaseado Gym.\c\nWhat do you think of challenging Gym Leader\nGrusha up on Glaseado Mountain?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_06

entries.text: I think you should try the Montenevera Gym next.\c\nYou could try challenging Gym Leader Ryme\nin chilly Montenevera!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_07

entries.text: I’d say, how about the Alfornada Gym?\c\nHave you considered taking on Gym Leader Tulip\nin scorching Alfornada?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_08

entries.text: I’d say make for the lair of the Rock-type Titan!\c\nWhy not try to seek out the Pokémon known as\nthe Stony Cliff Titan?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_09

entries.text: I’d say make for the lair of the Steel-type Titan!\c\nMaybe try seeking out the Pokémon known as\nthe Lurking Steel Titan?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_10

entries.text: I’d say make for the lair of the Flying-type Titan!\c\nThink you might be up to seeking out the\nso-called Open Sky Titan?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_11

entries.text: I’d say make for the lair of the Ground-type Titan!\c\nDo you dare seek out the Pokémon that has been\ncalled the Quaking Earth Titan?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_12

entries.text: I’d say make for the lair of the Dragon-type Titan!\c\nWhy not seek out the Pokémon called the\nFalse Dragon Titan?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_13

entries.text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fairy crew!\c\nOrtega, the boss of the Ruchbah Squad, would\nprobably welcome a challenge, from what I hear.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_14

entries.text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Dark crew!\c\nI hear Giacomo, the boss of the Segin Squad,\nis just waiting for someone to battle.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_15

entries.text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fire crew!\c\nSeems like Mela, the boss of the Schedar Squad,\nis burning for someone to battle against.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_16

entries.text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Poison crew!\c\nAtticus, the boss of the Navi Squad, is apparently\nwaiting for someone to battle.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_17

entries.text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fighting crew!\c\nI’m pretty sure Eri, the boss of the Caph Squad,\ncould use a good challenge in battle.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_18

entries.text: Go to Area Zero in the Great Crater of Paldea!\c\nI think you’ve got some tried-and-true friends\nwaiting for you there.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_19

entries.text: I’ll go ahead and mark the spot in your map app\nfor you.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_02

entries.text: You’ve got a destination set in your map app\nalready. Is it OK if I replace it with this one?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_03

entries.text: All right...you’re all set! Go out there and have\nan adventure—we’ll be here when you need us!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_04

entries.text: All righty—I’ll leave your map be! Have fun\nexploring, and we’ll be here when you need us!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_05

entries.text:
Feliz cumpleaños! Congratulations on your
birthday!\c
I do hope you keep visiting the Pokémon Center
for many years to come!\c
Now, are you here to let your Pokémon rest?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_03_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 134]

entries.text: Happy birthday, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_birthday_01

entries.text: I do hope this will be a wonderful year for you—\neach and every day!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_birthday_02

entries.text: Oh, today is a special day, isn’t it?\c\nI know it’s actually a day early, but we wish you\na very happy birthday!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_birthday_03

entries.text: First, let’s restore your Pokémon to full health.
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_pc_01

entries.text:
Be sure to visit a Pokémon Center whenever your
Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare running low on HP.\c
And if you’re planning to go far off the beaten
path, you should probably remember to stock
up on Potions from the Poké Mart, too.\c
Good luck out there, Trainer!
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_01

entries.text: Your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare all happy and healthy again!\nGood luck out there, and take care!
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_02

entries.text: Study hard and play hard, that’s what I say!\nYou should enjoy your days as a student.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: msg_common_mama_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, good to have you home,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
Your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare looking a bit weary, though.
Why don’t you have a nice rest together?\c
... ... ...
... ... ...[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_mama_01

entries.text:
There you are! A nice long nap is all a body
needs to feel ready for more adventure, right?\c
Doesn’t matter whether you’re a person or a
Pokémon—we all need to take time to rest.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_mama_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Certainly! Allow me to get your birthday\nregistered in our system,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_01

entries.text: Now, do be careful you enter it right. You can’t\nchange your birthday after it’s registered.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_02

entries.text: So I’ve got here a birthday of [VAR 0x0201(0001)]/[VAR 0x0201(0002)] for one\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Is that right?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_03

entries.text: That’s right!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_select_01

entries.text: Let me change it
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_select_02

entries.text: Never mind
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_select_03

entries.text: Thanks for registering your birthday with the\nPokémon Center!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_04

entries.text: You should stop by on your big day, too!\nWe’ll be expecting you on [VAR 0x0201(0001)]/[VAR 0x0201(0002)]!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_05

entries.text: Oh, and if your very special birthday isn’t on the\ncalendar this year, then please come on 2/28!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_06

entries.text: Oh! By the way—did you know...?
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_00

entries.text: Or did you already know that? Well, I do hope\nmy little tidbits come in handy!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_01

entries.text:
With all the little tidbits that I’ve shared with you
so far, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
you should now know just about everything you
need as you go adventuring!\c
Flip back through your Adventure Guide from
time to time, though, as you enjoy exploring!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_02

entries.text: Now that you have a Hall of Fame Badge,\nI’ve unlocked the Judge function for you.

entries.text:
You know, you’d better visit a Pokémon Center
whenever your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare running low on HP.\c
And you should stock up on, like, lotsa Potions
and stuff at Peachy’s or wherever.
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_01_s1

entries.text:
Anyway, I healed up your Pokémon—all happy
and healthy again.\c
I’m glad they’re all OK. Be more careful out
there, would ya?
entries.label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_02_s1

entries.text:
Whoa. Gimme some room to breathe here,
would ya?\c
If you want me to heal your Pokémon, I’m gonna
need you over on the other side of the counter.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_freetalk_01_01_s1

entries.text: Y’know...I keep seeing you around here,\nso I thought I’d ask...
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_00_s1

entries.text: Has anyone taught you the new pose that\neverybody’s using in their selfies nowadays?\r\nIt’s like a double peace sign but with a twist.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_01_s1

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Upside-Down Peace emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nthe Pokémon Center lady!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_02_s1

entries.text: Maybe give it a try sometime, if you feel like it.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_03_s1

entries.text: Y’know...you sure do visit me a whole lot. I’d\nsay you’ve probably earned another sweet tip.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_04_s1

entries.text: So when you’re taking a selfie, right? Try holding\na Poké Ball up all close to your face.\c\nIt’ll make you look super cute. You should try it.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_05_s1

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Poké Ball emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from the\nPokémon Center lady!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_06_s1

entries.text: If you’re feeling like you need just a touch more\ncute in a shot, you should give it a try.
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_07_s1

entries.text: Oh, and that’s right—I have a new tip to share\nwith you!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_04

till now, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
you probably know just about everything you

entries.text: Oh no! Are you OK?! We’d better get your\nPokémon healed up at once!
entries.label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_self_05

entries.text:
You should be a bit more diligent in healing up
your Pokémon when they’re getting weak.\c
It helps if you load up on Potions from the
vending machine!

entries.text: Looks like your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare all healed now.\nTime to get back to adventuring!
